title: Shut the Door to Catch the Thief
era: Mid Warring States · about 2,300 years ago

source.chapter: Shut the Door to Catch the Thief
source.quote: Box in the small enemy. Splitting apart: it does not further one to go anywhere.

moral: Before you move, think through how he could still get away.
transfer: Agree on rules and endings before you play.
